scope: Isolated matched PPO, PBRS, and PBRS plus successful C749 anchors. Inference contract and source are frozen.
optimizer: Fresh Adam eps 1e-5. Unmodified joint PPO clipping and GAE.
curriculum: Existing mixed map pool plus byte-exact previously used training key backtrack fixture. One initial worker per family. Subsequent per-worker resets use 25% probability for each of combat, navigation, progression, mixed-survival and uniform probability within a family.
spawn_policy: Existing immutable training WAD positions and headings, identical choice streams per worker in all arms.
reward: Unchanged progression profile in all arms. PBRS applies only on the two exact allowlisted red key training fixtures at gamma .99.
loss: C adds beta times mean sum of six head KLs from fixed C749 targets drawn evenly from present success categories. Anchor replay has no PPO importance ratio.
